Junior Platform Engineer

Vector Freight moves twelve thousand loads a day, and every one of them is priced, dispatched, and tracked by the platform team. We are hiring a junior engineer to work on the dispatch service and the APIs that sit in front of it.

This is a hybrid role based in Chicago, with two days a week in the office and a start date in the summer of 2027.

What you will work on

  • Backend services in Go, deployed to Kubernetes on AWS
  • A PostgreSQL data model that carries load, carrier, and pricing history
  • Event pipelines built on Kafka that feed the pricing model
  • Internal tooling that dispatchers use for eight hours a day

What we are looking for

  • A bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent practical experience
  • Working knowledge of at least one compiled language, Go preferred
  • Comfort writing SQL against a relational database
  • An interest in operating what you build, not throwing it over a wall

We sponsor H-1B and TN visas for this role. Vector Freight is an equal opportunity employer.
